headline: Cannes 2026: Why American cinema is not taking center stage on the Croisette this year
subhead: Although the history of Cannes is inseparable from that of US filmmaking, the highly anticipated American feature films are few and far between in this year's lineup. The official reason is a series of events that slowed a number of projects. But there is also a growing lack of interest in auteur films from both Hollywood and streaming platforms.

subhead: Prompted by several governments, including those led by Giorgia Meloni of Italy and Mette Frederiksen  of Denmark, the 46 member states have issued a political declaration aimed at tightening the European Court of Human Rights' (ECHR) case law on migrant rights.

headline: Eurovision 2026: Israel's participation sparks controversy
subhead: In an unprecedented move, five countries – Spain, Ireland, Iceland, the Netherlands and Slovenia – are boycotting the event in protest over the presence of an Israeli contestant. Pro-Palestinian demonstrations are also planned in Vienna, where the final will be held on Saturday, May 16.

headline: Thomas Piketty: 'The left must reconnect with its egalitarian ambitions of the past'
subhead: The divide between the Trumpist, merchant and nationalist right and the liberal Democratic left is largely artificial, argues economist Thomas Piketty. In his view, this story helps elites on both sides reinforce their hold over the working class and blocks the emergence of a genuine popular alternative.

subhead: Emmanuel Macron, who will leave office on May 13, 2027, seeks to be remembered as a president who stayed active until the end. On the world stage, he recently regained some of the credit he lost to domestic challenges.

headline: 'Zinédine Zidane maintains a political and social awareness that is deeply connected to his own story'
subhead: The sociologist Stéphane Beaud explored in an essay the football player's career, framing it within that of the descendants of Algerian immigrants. In an interview, he explains that the athlete tried to make up for the injustices suffered by his father, who remained at the bottom of the social ladder throughout his life.
